summary: Comprehensive testing of Sign Shop SaaS order workflow - New Order form, dynamic category fields, live pricing, apparel size breakdown, vehicle wrap coverage, order creation, quote/invoice/work order generation, and ticket shortcut actions. All features working correctly after one minor fix.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order workflow fully tested. Fixed two issues: 1) JobTicketSpecs model had grommets/hemming as bool but schema sends string values - changed to str type. 2) LivePricingPreview was sending material value as vinyl_type for non-vinyl categories causing 500 errors - fixed to only set vinyl_type for cut_vinyl and vehicle_wrap categories.

new_order_form.details: Form loads correctly with customer section, order info, and job tickets section with Quick Entry and Detailed Entry buttons

live_estimate_updates.details: Live pricing preview updates correctly when dimensions, material, and specs change. Shows Material, Labor, Overhead, Cost, Markup %, and Estimated Sell Price. Fixed vinyl_type mapping issue for non-vinyl categories.

apparel_size_breakdown.details: Size breakdown (XS-5XL) correctly sums to Total and auto-updates Quantity field. Tested with S=5, M=10, L=8, XL=2 = Total 25

vehicle_wrap_coverage_pricing.details: Coverage level and coverage percent fields work correctly. Pricing calculation includes vehicle type and coverage options.

order_creation.details: Order created successfully via UI with Save Order button. Order detail page shows correct summary cards (TICKETS, ESTIMATE, PROGRESS, DUE, PAYMENT, SOURCE)

ticket_pricing_snapshot.details: Created ticket saves calculated estimate ($63.35 for 4x2 ft banner) into backend and displays in order totals

quote_invoice_work_order_generation.details: Generate dropdown shows Quote, Invoice, Work Order options. All three generated successfully and appear in Financial tab with correct totals

financial_tab.details: Financial tab shows QUOTES (1), INVOICES (1), WORK ORDERS (1) sections with document details and amounts

assign_employee.details: Dialog shows employee dropdown with 'Also assign all existing production tasks' checkbox

add_to_schedule.details: Dialog shows employee, date, start/end time, notes (auto-filled with ticket info), and checkboxes for ticket/task assignment

create_task.details: Dialog shows task title (auto-filled), description (with order/ticket context), assignee, and due date

production_workflow.details: Start Production button correctly disabled when order is in 'Awaiting Quote' status. Backend tests confirm production start creates tasks for workflow-enabled tickets.

fixes_applied.issue: JobTicketSpecs model had grommets and hemming as bool type, but dynamic schema sends string values like 'corners', 'every_2ft', 'all_sides'
fixes_applied.fix: Changed grommets, hemming, and double_sided fields from bool to str type to accept schema values

fixes_applied.issue: vinyl_type was being set to specs.material for all categories, causing 500 errors when banner_13oz was sent as vinyl_type
fixes_applied.fix: Only set vinyl_type for cut_vinyl and vehicle_wrap categories, null for others
